title: 独立电磁炉

source.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: reusable transparent paper-theatre animation cutout. Primary request: one standalone compact induction cooktop for a Chinese home kitchen preparation scene. Subject: single low rectangular black induction cooker with one simple circular burner mark and a small blank control strip, viewed from a gentle top-down three-quarter angle; no pan, no pot, no hand. Style/medium: refined tactile cut-paper collage with subtle paper grain, restrained charcoal and muted sage accents, crisp silhouette. Composition/framing: one object centered and fully visible with generous transparent margin. Background: genuinely transparent alpha. Constraints: no readable text, no numbers, no logo, no cord, no food, no flame, no smoke, no counter background, no cast shadow, no glow, no watermark.

discovery.usage_notes: 独立静态设备层；不含火焰、烟雾或数值显示。

usage_notes: 与炒锅独立叠放；不凭设备图形宣称已经发生加热。
